description: SurfCAD agent guide, plain text. guide { topic } returns one topic; guide {} lists them. Read "start" before the first model call, and "chat" (the required in-viewer chat workflow) after every pair. Topics: start (How to build in SurfCAD (block, build, polish, place), a three-call example, how to read results, and the closing reply for an in-viewer prompt (the required chat workflow is the chat topic)); dialect (Every script helper by signature, in ribbon-order groups, rendered from the helper registry; list_helpers has the full docs); features (Marker blocks, feature ids, edit / delete / rollback / undo, script snippets, sketches); selection (Face and edge keys, list_faces filters, single-use picks, no_selection, fillet edge sets); paint (paint_open → paint_set_color → paint_part / paint_faces → paint_confirm; colours persist with the assembly); limits (The 30 s kernel budget, what is slow, worker restarts and stale status, result sizes, pairing errors); camera (Which side each named view looks from, explicit poses, select_clear before a screenshot, screenshot to file); assembly (Documents, create_part placement, insert by reference, part instances, joint_create as the default assembly path, hardware, git_save); modeling (3D modeling guidelines: build on the create_assembly seed part (never create_part for the first part); required blend order draft, shell, concave, then convex fillets and chamfers, edges picked by name; the shell opening; shell-after-fillet playtest cases A to D; reuse (instances, mirror, patterns) over rebuilding, joints, check bodyCount); molding (Injection molding design rules: draft 1° (0.5° vertical band), walls 1 to 6.35 mm with 0.6× / 1.5× thin and thick flags, ribs, ejector side, slides and lifters (15/20/25°), parting line and rib bases stay sharp, what mold_fit checks); chat (REQUIRED in-viewer chat workflow: idle wake (automatic at pair where the host provides it; the pair note says if it is ready), register_webhook after every pair, ack first (set_status responding), one short non-final reply, building / post_progress, final reply, and the 10 second read_messages long-poll while connected (polling is not activity)). Error recoveries: errors.<code> for the code an error payload carries (its see field names the topic), e.g. errors.no_selection, errors.unknown_face, errors.unknown_edge. The same texts are the surfcad://guide/<topic> resources.

topic.description: Which topic to read. Omit to list the topics with one line each.
